data.desc: ICON plc is a world-leading clinical research organization. Offering deep operational and medical expertise we accelerate innovation, driving emerging therapies forward to improve patient outcomes. From molecule to medicine, we deliver integrated consulting, clinical development, commercialization and post-marketing solutions to pharmaceutical, biotechnology, medical device, government and public health organizations worldwide. With headquarters in Dublin, Ireland , ICON employed approximately 40,250 employees in 98 locations in 55 countries as at September 30, 2026 . For further information about ICON, visit: www.iconplc.com .
